```{r important libraries, include=FALSE}
# Clear workspace
rm(list = ls())

# Set knitr defaults
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

# Load required packages
library(tidyverse)
library(broom)      
library(ggpubr)     
library(readxl)
library(reshape2)
library(lattice)
library(data.table)
library(car)          # Type II/III ANOVA
library(BayesFactor)
library(RColorBrewer)
```

```{r update directories based on where folders are located, echo=FALSE}

#directory configuration change base_path with directory location for folders

base_path<-"C:/Users/julia/OneDrive/Desktop"

#cleaned data directories
ToD_VideoData_Dir <- file.path(base_path, "Cleaned_ToD_VideoData") #directory for video data 
ToD_NonVideoData_Dir <- file.path(base_path, "Cleaned_ToD_NonVideoData") #directory for non-video data 

#demo sleep directory
Demo_Sleep_Dir_Video<- file.path(ToD_VideoData_Dir, "Demo_Sleep") #video demo dir
Demo_Sleep_Dir_NonVideo<- file.path(ToD_NonVideoData_Dir, "Demo_Sleep") #non-video demo dir

#combined video and non-video output directory 
ToD_Video_NonVideo_Dir<- file.path(base_path, "ToD_Video_NonVideo_Data")

#Figure Directory 
Figure_Directory<- file.path(ToD_Video_NonVideo_Dir, "Figures")


```


```{r Combine Video and Non-Video memory, demo and sleep data, echo=FALSE}

# Non-video memory data
ToD_NonVideo <- read.csv(file.path(ToD_NonVideoData_Dir, "MemoryABS_Rec_NonVideo.csv")) %>%
  mutate(ExpFormat = "Non_Video",
         collected_by = "Julia") %>%
  select(-Date)

# Video memory data
ToD_Video <- read.csv(file.path(ToD_VideoData_Dir, "MemoryABS_Rec_Video.csv")) %>%
  rename(SubID = participant) %>%
  mutate(ExpFormat = "Video")

# Combine memory datasets
MemDataOnlineVideo <- bind_rows(ToD_NonVideo, ToD_Video)

# Save combined memory dataset 
write.csv(MemDataOnlineVideo,
          file.path(ToD_Video_NonVideo_Dir, "MemoryABS_Rec_Video_NonVideo.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)

# Load in Non-video sleep and demographics data 
MEQ_PSQI_NonVideo <- read.csv(file.path(Demo_Sleep_Dir_NonVideo,
                                        "PSQI_MEQ_Cond_Ages_All_NonVideo.csv")) %>%
  select(-Date, -Distractor, -Distractor_MEQ) %>%
  filter(SubID != "Sub067_ToD_Online") %>%   # Remove excluded participant
  mutate(collected_by = "Julia",
         ExpFormat = "Non_Video")

# load in Video sleep and demographics data 
MEQ_PSQI_Video <- read.csv(file.path(Demo_Sleep_Dir_Video,
                                     "PSQI_MEQ_Cond_Ages_All_Video.csv")) %>%
  rename(SubID = participant) %>%
  mutate(ExpFormat = "Video")

# Combine sleep demographics from two experiment formats
MEQ_PSQI_Video_NonVideo <- bind_rows(MEQ_PSQI_NonVideo, MEQ_PSQI_Video)

# Remove duplicated columns before merge
MEQ_PSQI_Video_NonVideo_Merge <- MEQ_PSQI_Video_NonVideo %>%
  select(-AgeGroup, -ToD_Condition, -collected_by, -ExpFormat)

# Merge sleep and demo data with memory data
Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid <- merge(MEQ_PSQI_Video_NonVideo_Merge,
                                      MemDataOnlineVideo,
                                      by = "SubID") %>%
  relocate(ExpFormat, .before = psqi_1) %>%
  relocate(AgeGroup:ToD_Condition, .after = SubID) %>%
  relocate(age:education_years, .after = SubID)

# Save final memory, sleep and demo data combined both experiment formats
write.csv(Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid,
          file.path(ToD_Video_NonVideo_Dir, "Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid_FinalData.csv"),
          row.names = FALSE)


```


```{r Recognition Memory Analysis andPlot , include=FALSE}

#### code for Recognition Memory Analysis and Plot#### ###

#recode factors
Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid <- Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid %>%
  mutate(
    ExpFormat = dplyr::recode(ExpFormat,
                              "Non_Video" = "Non-Video",
                              "Video"     = "Video"),
    ToD_Condition = dplyr::recode(ToD_Condition,
                                  "Night" = "Evening"),
    AgeGroup = dplyr::recode(AgeGroup,
                             "YA" = "Young",
                             "OA" = "Old"),
    AgeGroup = factor(AgeGroup),
    ToD_Condition = factor(ToD_Condition),
    ExpFormat = factor(ExpFormat)
  )


#three way ANOVA age group, time of day, exp format on recognition memory : bays Factors calc using JASP

options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
RecognitionScoreModel <- lm(
  RecognitionScore ~ AgeGroup * ToD_Condition * ExpFormat,
  data = Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid
)
Anova(RecognitionScoreModel, type = 3)


#set colors for plotting
selected_colorsRec <- c(
  "Evening"=brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")[9],    #blue
  "Morning"=brewer.pal(11, "PuOr")[3]   # orange
)


theme_set(
  theme_bw() +
    theme(text = element_text(family = "Arial"))
)


RecScore_Age_Format_ToD<-ggplot(Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid,
       aes(x = AgeGroup, y = RecognitionScore, fill = ToD_Condition)) +
  stat_summary(fun = mean,
               geom = "bar",
               position = position_dodge(0.9)) +
  stat_summary(fun.data = mean_se,
               geom = "errorbar",
               position = position_dodge(0.9),
               width = 0.2) +
  facet_wrap(~ExpFormat) +
  ylim(0, 1) +
  labs(
    y = "Recognition Score",
    x = "Age Group",
    fill = "Time of Day"
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = selected_colorsRec) +
  theme_classic()+
theme(
  aspect.ratio = 1
)+
  theme(
    legend.text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold"),
    legend.title = element_text(size = 13, face = "bold"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 12,face="bold"),
    axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
    strip.text = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
  )

#save recognition plot

RecScore_Age_Format_ToD
# save plots with high resolution
ggsave(
  filename =file.path(Figure_Directory,"RecScore.jpeg"),
  plot = RecScore_Age_Format_ToD, width = 5.2, height = 3)


# Save plot to strict PLOS ONE specifications
ggsave(
filename =file.path(Figure_Directory,"RecScore.tif"),
  plot = RecScore_Age_Format_ToD, 
  device = "tiff",        
  width = 5.2,           
  height = 3,          
  units = "in",           
  dpi = 300,              
  compression = "lzw"     
)



```



```{r MEQ Analysis, Plot and Scoring Explanation, include=FALSE}


#calculate MEQ summary Stats by age and time of day
MEQ_Summary <- Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid %>%
  group_by(AgeGroup, ToD_Condition) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MEQ = mean(MEQScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_MEQ = sd(MEQScore, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

age_MEQ_summary <- Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid %>%
  group_by(AgeGroup) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_MEQ = mean(MEQScore, na.rm = TRUE),
    se_MEQ = sd(MEQScore, na.rm = TRUE) / sqrt(n()),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

#anova for MEQ, Bayes Factors calc using JASP
options(contrasts = c("contr.sum", "contr.poly"))
anova_result_MEQ <- lm(
  MEQScore ~ AgeGroup * ToD_Condition,
  data = Memory_Sleep_Demo_Vid_NonVid
)
Anova(anova_result_MEQ, type = 3)


#colors for plotting MEQ
selected_colors_MEQ <- brewer.pal(5, "Set1")[c(4, 2)] 

MEQLine<-ggplot(MEQ_Summary, aes(x = ToD_Condition, y = mean_MEQ, 
                       group = AgeGroup, color = AgeGroup)) +
  
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  geom_point(size = 3) +
  
  geom_errorbar(aes(ymin = mean_MEQ - se_MEQ, 
                    ymax = mean_MEQ + se_MEQ), 
                width = 0.1) +

  scale_color_manual(values = selected_colors_MEQ) +
  scale_y_continuous(limits = c(45, 65), breaks = seq(45, 65, 5))+

  
  labs(
    x = "Time of Day",
    y = "Mean MEQ Score",
    colour = "Age Group"#,
    #title = "Mean MEQ Scores by Age Group and Time of Day"
  ) +
  
 theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
theme(
  panel.grid = element_blank(),   # removes grid lines ✅
  axis.line = element_line(colour = "black"),  # adds axis lines
  plot.title = element_text(size = 18, face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 16, face = "bold"),
  axis.text = element_text(size = 13),
  legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
  legend.text = element_text(size = 13)
)

#save MEQ plot
ggsave(
  filename =file.path(Figure_Directory,"MEQLine.jpg"), plot = MEQLine, bg = "transparent", width = 5, height = 3, dpi = 600)


# Save plot to strict PLOS ONE specifications
ggsave(
  filename = file.path(Figure_Directory,"MEQLine.tif"),
  plot = MEQLine, 
  device = "tiff",        
  width = 5,            
  height = 3,          
  units = "in",          
  dpi = 400,             
  compression = "lzw"     
)
```
